_comment: Backlog row 250 EXIT-recovery battery. Run only in a detached scratch clone: venv/bin/python toolchain/bin/bd-mutate --spec tests/mutants/row_250_deploy_exit_recovery.json --work DETACHED_SCRATCH --timeout 300. M1 removes the unconditional EXIT guard and must be caught by a fixture command that reaches step 9, fails under errexit without calling die, and observes the fake service boundary. M2 removes the explicit re-entry barrier and must be caught by a die-triggered EXIT whose handler is already marked active. The separate row_250_deploy_exit_recovery_transform_control.json applies M1 to the syntax-only control and must ESCAPE, proving the transform remains valid and the behavioral catcher supplies the CAUGHT verdict.
subject: backlog row 250 - every unsuccessful exit from the stopped deploy window attempts exactly one reported service recovery

mutants.label: M1 remove the EXIT guard so a bare step-9 errexit leaves the fixture service stopped and prints no recovery outcome
